title: CSS Cascade Resolution with @layer
description: Observe evaluation order across origins, named layers, and specificity.

steps.label: 1. Declaring Layer Order
steps.description: @layer reset, base, components; locks in the hierarchy on the first line of CSS.

steps.label: 2. Cross-Layer Comparison
steps.description: An #app .btn (0,2,0) selector inside @layer base loses to .btn (0,1,0) inside @layer components.
steps.codeHighlight:
@layer base { #app .btn { color: red; } }
@layer components { .btn { color: blue; } }

steps.label: 3. Unlayered Rules
steps.description: Any rule outside @layer lands in the final anonymous layer and beats all named layers.
